MethodCall admission now requires exact resolution certainty and exact invocation, CallSite, and resolution evidence; the conservative-resolution negative passes.

notes: Bounded local presentation precedes configurable roots because CT-2 already supplies exact Web roots and the owner prioritized the earliest useful diagrams.
Five distinct test claims cover root-only SC001 projection, exact order/branch membership, consolidated material negatives, duplicate-anchor determinism, and generic planner presentation.
Projection requires one complete DirectExact CallSite per canonical operation and never traverses the target body.
Review resolution added two distinct claims for conservative resolution withholding and collision/reserved-safe participant keys; focused verification passes 40 Scenario and 13 Wording tests.

External regeneration proved exact root-call phrases for configuration, generated SOAP-client transfer, and notification calls. Their Mermaid messages were correctly withheld because existing SC013 topology cannot safely place these guarded calls; the first useful diagram milestone remains open and predicate/terminal topology is next.
